answers.1_derivative_consistent_representation: Yes, within the qualified default B1.10/unimodal four-material prescribed-head wet-mid-dry envelope. It passes 12/12 frozen fidelity cases and preserves analytical nonlinear iterations and backtracking in all 12.
answers.2_domain_that_must_be_represented: Near saturation h>-1 cm remains authoritative analytical. The ordinary lookup domain can cover the scientifically relevant unsaturated range, but adaptive refinement must not chase the extreme-dry storage tail indefinitely. For O05 the authoritative raw C=1e-13 crossing is about h=-264277.5 cm. The historical dt*1e-13 item is Jacobian regularization, not a K or theta cutoff. An explicit dry-tail termination/asymptotic rule remains separately unqualified.
answers.3_robust_end_to_end_Richards_speedup: Across B01,B12,O05,O14 and wet,mid,dry prescribed-head fixtures, complete Richards CPU reduction is about 20.5-24.2 percent. The self-built cached provider retains about 20.0 percent median reduction in its Stage-3 paired timing. These are controlled Richards results, not whole-SWAP wall-time claims.

the strict derivative-consistent lookup is therefore not qualified as a universal prescribed-qbot provider

central_scientific_answer: An automatically generated, branch-aware and derivative-consistent hydraulic representation can materially reduce Richards computational cost while preserving scientifically relevant solution and nonlinear convergence behaviour, but only within a qualified solver/boundary envelope. Derivative consistency is necessary and strongly beneficial, yet not sufficient for universal Newton-path invariance under boundary-sensitive prescribed-flux conditions.
hypothesis_outcome: Supported but refined: preserving mathematical state-derivative consistency is more important than independently minimizing interpolation error, but solver-facing trajectory sensitivity and boundary semantics can still dominate once derivative consistency is satisfied.
broader_model_envelope_blocker: The current typed authoritative production provider is deliberately limited to the default MvG/B1.10 profile. Historical SWAP contains exponential, bimodal MvG and PDI families, but extending F-AHL across them requires a separately qualified authoritative provider/family contract before a strict cross-family representation claim can be made.
